title: Cold-pressed vs refined
caption:
Is your cooking oil really cold-pressed? 🫒 Label Check #1

Refined oil is usually extracted at high heat, often with chemical solvents, then bleached and deodorised.

Cold-pressed oil comes from seeds pressed slowly at low heat, with no solvents, so it keeps its natural aroma and taste.

Groundnut and sesame for South Indian cooking. Mustard for North Indian tadka.
